rules.sentence: Cyanotic heart defects are typically from right-to-left shunts in blood after birth.

Examples of cyanotic heart defects are tetralogy of Fallot (TOF), transposition of the great arteries (TGA), persistent truncus arteriosus, tricuspid atresia, and total anomalous pulmonary venous return (TAPVR).

Acyanotic heart defects are typically left-to-right shunts in blood after birth.
Examples of acyanotic heart defects are atrial septal defect (ASD), ventricular septal defect (VSD), patent ductus arteriosus (PDA), and patent foramen ovale (PFO).
